links.outcome: FIT opt-in rate by patient language subgroup (Spanish vs English) after AI outreach
links.effect: FIT opt-in 18.2% vs 7.1% (p<0.001); Spanish preference independent predictor, adjusted OR 2.012 (95% CI 1.340-3.019). Spanish-speaking patients had higher engagement across all measures.
links.quote: In multivariate analysis, Spanish language preference remained an independent predictor of FIT test opt-in (adjusted OR 2.012, 95% CI 1.340-3.019, p<0.001) after controlling for demographic factors and call duration.

unlisted_practices: Language-concordant bilingual AI voice outreach for preventive screening

screen.reason: Evaluates a real-world deployment of a bilingual AI conversational care agent for outreach and compares engagement and screening opt-in between Spanish- and English-speaking patients.
